_about: The Biblical Illustrator, ed. Joseph S. Exell (1849-1909), the American Revell issue (catalogued 1905), the volumes University of Toronto holds on the Internet Archive: 32 of the set's roughly 57. Each row names the book read from the volume's running heads (the I Chronicles and New Testament index volumes also from their title pages); a volume can bind further books after the one named, and where a book runs to several volumes the row says only which book. Added 2026-11-03 by lane A from Adam's Libronix inventory; Internet Archive OCR, raw. No uids minted. Exell died 1909 and every contributor's text is pre-1910, so US public domain.
